description_for_human: Search U.S. nonprofits for Form 990 financials, governance checks, grant flows, trust signals, and due diligence evidence.
description_for_model: Use CharitySense for U.S. nonprofit due diligence, donor-intent search, charity comparison, Form 990 financial analysis, governance checks, grant flows, related organizations, ratings, and beneficiary geography. Search first, fetch the bounded charity page, then fetch only advertised section IDs. Core research GETs require no token; the derived reads and Advanced operations require a paid key. Advanced operations require the paid-key security declared in OpenAPI. Every documented POST is consequential and requires user confirmation. Cite the canonical charity profile and include the filing year when using financial evidence.
